preservedCoverage: Confirmed: existing same-span-group members are excluded from new groups and unresolved; all such groups remain referenced through preservedGroupIds. Every remaining observation belongs once to a new group or unresolved. Do not drop contact/education/certification; out_of_scope_field does not mean missing qualification.
structuralCasing: Use ASCII-case-insensitive matching for approved exact English headings and Employer/Role/Dates labels, with structural whitespace only. Preserve all observed values/citations unchanged; no Unicode normalization or loose heading/proximity inference. Uppercase/lowercase common headings must remain supported.
context: An unsupported/unlabelled nonblank span, recognized nonemployment heading or out-of-scope labelled content ends block and employment eligibility until a new supported employment heading. Blank ends only the current block. Document this conservative v1 scope; ordinary unsupported layouts stay unresolved rather than claimed handled.
preflight: Check resource caps before expensive replay, then actual schema/binding validation. Do not lower valid envelope limits.
consumer: UI derives loader-local metadata only after owned replay; no additional shared readmodel DTO field or canonical correction fixture coupling. Do not offer association acknowledgement until a separately reviewed durable command exists.
